selection_rule: Top10 by pre-test CSI300 weight, baseline 2015-2017 coverage>=.98, positive volume>=.95, listed before 2015; first5 eligible each sector. No outcome/survival filter.

analysis_plan.status: design specification; dependence calibration unvalidated; no real test results
main_questions: three within-sector equality tests, five stock populations each
one between-sector equality test, three equal-weight five-stock mixtures
analysis_plan.primary_pvalue_adjustment: Holm across the four main MCA tests
analysis_plan.bootstrap_mask_handling: Resample full-calendar panel and common-validity marker together; compute AUC on selected complete rows, keep original calendar gaps; fixed observed AUC scales.
analysis_plan.mca_centering: (AUC_boot_component - AUC_observed_component)/fixed_observed_scale, then maximum across populations and learners
analysis_plan.distance: Gaussian-kernel MMD, unsquared, with one pooled fitting-only scale and one fitting-only median bandwidth for all stock/sector pairs
analysis_plan.contrast: Equally average 75 cross-sector stock-pair distances minus equally average 30 within-sector stock-pair distances; same five stocks/sector.
analysis_plan.distance_uncertainty: Synchronously bootstrap centered RKHS mean-difference errors; common 95% radius across 105 stock pairs and three sector-mixture pairs; derive simultaneous distance bounds and conservative contrast interval.
analysis_plan.different_inference_families: Four MCA tests have Holm familywise .05; the distance family has simultaneous .95 coverage. Do not claim .95 coverage for the union of both families.
analysis_plan.pilot_rule: First smoke/100-rep numerical pilot, then 1000-rep validation. Freeze changes from null simulations, never from real test p values.
null_scenarios: same-marginal Gaussian panels with asymmetric cross-stock correlation
stress_scenarios: common volatility breaks (outside stationary baseline assumptions)
positive_controls: within-sector equality plus between-sector mean/scale/dependence shifts
one genuinely deviating stock within a sector
analysis_plan.equivalence_claim: Not included without an author-defined substantive discrepancy tolerance
analysis_plan.comparators: Do not transfer this AUC calibration mechanically to degenerate DISCO/MMD null statistics or MST graphs; their inferential calibrations require separate validation.

missingness_policy: Keep original block indices and joint validity mask. No compression of gaps, no synthetic filling, no changing selected stocks from post-2017 missingness.
inference_status: Calendar missingness and dependence calibration require validation before main inference. Equal mixtures refer to the selected fixed panel, not all sector stocks.
